answer.book: Rodolphus Goclenius, De vita proroganda (Frankfurt/Mainz 1608): a single Latin treatise on preserving health and prolonging life, preceded by title pages, dedications, prefatory letters and commendatory verses, then 21 numbered chapters with some numbered quaestiones inside them, followed by an index.
